pr.title: Let delegates read statements
pr.body:
Adds a `delegate` role. Owners grant and revoke delegates with `Ledger.grant` and `Ledger.revoke`; `can_view` admits a delegate only for accounts that list them.

Closes #5.

issues.title: Let owners delegate statement access
issues.body:
Owners want an accountant to read their statements without sharing credentials.

Acceptance:

1. An account owner can grant another user read-only access to that account's statement, and revoke it.
2. Only the account's owner can grant or revoke; anyone else gets `LedgerError` and nothing changes.
3. A delegate can view only the accounts that granted them access.
4. A delegate can never post entries.
5. Owner, auditor, and teller access is unchanged.
